stem.text: Coherent light of constant wavelength is incident normally on a double slit. Interference fringes are formed on a screen that is a fixed distance from the double slit. The screen is parallel to the double slit.
The separation of the slits is varied.
Which graph best shows the variation with slit separation $a$ of the spacing $x$ of the interference fringes?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled x and horizontal axis labelled a, origin marked 0.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled x and horizontal axis labelled a, origin marked 0.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled x and horizontal axis labelled a, origin marked 0.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled x and horizontal axis labelled a, origin marked 0.
